import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react"; const AgentDownload = () => { const [userToken, setUserToken] = useState(""); const [serverIP, setServerIP] = useState(""); useEffect(() => { setUserToken(localStorage.getItem("userToken") || "YOUR_API_TOKEN"); setServerIP(localStorage.getItem("serverIP") || "YOUR_SERVER_IP"); }, []); return (

✅ Download and Install the OptiWeb Monitoring Agent

Follow these steps to set up the monitoring agent on your server:

{/* Step 1 */}

1️⃣ Download the Agent

Run this command on your server:

            wget --no-check-certificate https://optiweb.lankapanel.net/static/agent.py -O agent.py
{/* Step 2 */}

2️⃣ Install Required Python Dependencies

Install libraries:

            pip install psutil requests

💡 Optionally, create a virtual environment:

{`python3 -m venv optiweb_env
source optiweb_env/bin/activate`}
{/* Step 3 */}

3️⃣ Create Configuration File

Create a file named config.json in the same folder as agent.py:

nano config.json

Paste this content:

{`{
  "backend_api": "http://203.143.13.21:8000/api/auth/metrics/",
  "web_server_ip": "${serverIP}",
  "token": "${userToken}"
}`}

✅ Replace values with your actual server IP and API token if not pre-filled.

{/* Step 4 */}

4️⃣ Run the Agent (Foreground)

Start the agent to view logs live:

            python3 agent.py

🔁 The agent sends data every 60 seconds in an infinite loop.

📍 To run in the background:

            nohup python3 agent.py > agent.log 2>&1 &

Check logs later:

            tail -f agent.log
{/* Step 5 */}

✅ 5️⃣ Verify in Dashboard

Your server metrics should appear under:

  • 🔍 Monitoring
  • ⚠️ ML Prediction
  • 🧾 Logs
  • 🔌 Service Status
